children: According to Wallstreetcn, Canada’s minister responsible for Canada-U.S. trade, Dominic LeBlanc, said on September 11 that there is no formal arrangement for trade talks with the United States, though he remains in contact with U.S. Trade Representative Greer and U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick.

title: Canada Says No Formal Trade Talks Are Scheduled With the U.S.
